I have farmed here in the North West for many years, so I know this land needs both urea and cow manure to give a good sorghum harvest, especially since I am planting the improved seed I bought from the agro-dealer in town because it matures faster than my father’s old seed and fights off the stem borers. I cannot irrigate, so I wait for the rains, but I will spray herbicide to keep the weeds down because my back is not what it used to be at fifty-five, and I will need about twenty days of hired help from the village youth for weeding and harvesting since my own children have gone to the city.
